questions.question: Schema bump for ui-inventory.schema.json (upready.ui-inventory/v0): totals.additionalProperties is false, so the propsUsed rollup that t-ds-0-foundation acceptance demands cannot be added without a bump. Proposed patch, minimal: add to totals.properties -> "propsUsedByComponent": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}}} = per component, prop name -> number of call sites that pass it. Per-entry propsUsed needs nothing: $defs.entry.props already carries the literal props of each call site. OK to bump to v0 in place (no consumer exists yet) or do you want upready.ui-inventory/v1? Orchestrator A proceeds meanwhile: the registry is built schema-valid without the rollup and the rollup is added the moment you answer.
